item.title: Police Department — Procurement: NYPD's Intelligence Database System (IDS)
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
Sole Source contract for maintenance & upgrades to NYPD's Intelligence Database System (IDS). The Intelligence Database System is a case management system used as the central repository for all NYPD counterterrorism leads, confidential informant credentials and sensitive investigation data . General Dynamics Information Technology Inc. is the sole manufacturer and provider of Intelligence Database System software and Intelligence Bureau Intranet support services.

item.title: New York City Police Pension Fund — Procurement: Virtual Chief Information Security Officer (vCISO) Services
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The New York City Police Pension Fund is seeking proposals from qualified and experienced firms to provide Virtual Chief Information Security Officer (vCISO) services. The selected firm will support the Fund in enhancing and maturing its cybersecurity program; strengthening cybersecurity governance, oversight, and accountability; improving cybersecurity risk visibility through metrics, reporting, and dashboards; enhancing incident preparedness, response, and recovery capabilities; and aligning cybersecurity practices with applicable New York City policies, standards, and fiduciary obligations.
